english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when people or things separate and go in different directions.
This is the all-purpose choice when people or things move apart in different directions.

examples.english: The crowd began to scatter as soon as they saw the police.
examples.traditional: 人群一見到警察就散開喇。

examples.english: The crowd began to disperse in all directions.
